options.content: Pilots: Live now · Traffic · New pilots · Origins · Records · Routes · Aircraft · Military | ATC: Overview · Retention · Hours · Positions · Ranks | Events: **Live events** · Monday events | Management: Monthly · Health All times are UTC. Figures cover VATPAC airspace. The live panels (online now, who is controlling) show the latest snapshot and refresh every minute; the event panels cover the Monday event window, 0700-1200Z. Panels without a period of their own use the page's fixed 180 days; the page has no inputs.

panels.title: Pilots online now (in region)
panels.description: Question F1 (v1 card 68), copied unchanged from Pilots: online now. Definition: pilots in Australian airspace in the latest network snapshot. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pilots_in_region AS "Pilots" FROM network_history ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Controllers online now
panels.description: Question F2 (v1 card 69), copied unchanged from ATC: controllers. Definition: controllers on the whitelist online in the latest network snapshot. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql: SELECT controllers_in_region AS "Controllers" FROM network_history ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Who is controlling now
panels.description: Question F3 (new). Definition: every whitelisted position being staffed now: callsign, controller name, rank (the rating on the session now), frequency, logon time and hours online. Online means seen in the latest snapshots and within the last 5 minutes. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign AS "Position", name AS "Controller", rank_group AS "Rank", frequency_mhz AS "Frequency (MHz)",
       logon_time AS "Logged on", hours_online AS "Hours online"
FROM controller_online_now
ORDER BY callsign

panels.title: Whitelisted positions staffed and open now, by type
panels.description: Question F3 (new). Definition: for each position type (suffix of the callsign) the number of whitelisted positions staffed now and open now (not staffed). The whitelist is config/controller_callsigns_list.txt (254 callsigns when this panel was written; copied into the query, and a test fails if it drifts from the file). Staffed uses the same 'online now' rule as the list of controllers. Times are UTC.

panels.title: Whitelisted positions open now

The whitelist is copied into the query (a test fails if it drifts from config/controller_callsigns_list.txt). Staffed uses the same 'online now' rule as the list of controllers. Times are UTC.

panels.title: Where pilots currently online come from
panels.description: Question F5 (v1 card 99), copied unchanged from Demographics: pilot origins and cohorts. Definition: home region of the pilots online now. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT region, count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM pilot_online_now
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY pilots DESC

panels.title: Latest Monday event attendance (0700-1200Z)
panels.description: Question F6 (v1 card 131), ADAPTED from Events: Monday event, not a plain copy (owner brief: only the latest Monday event). Definition: distinct pilot CIDs and distinct controller CIDs present at any time between 0700 and 1200 UTC on the most recent Monday whose 0700Z start has passed (before 0700Z on a Monday it shows the Monday before); sessions overlapping the window count. One row, read from the monday_attendance view as the original panel does. The original panel on Events: Monday event still shows every Monday. From 0700Z on a Monday the panel switches to that day's event, and the pilot figures are low or zero until about 2000Z because a flight is counted about 8 hours after its last position (controllers are live). Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(monday_date, 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "Event date (UTC)", pilot_cids AS "Pilots", controller_cids AS "Controllers"
FROM monday_attendance
WHERE monday_date = ((date_trunc('day', (now() - interval '7 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
          - (extract(isodow FROM (now() - interval '7 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int - 1) * interval '1 day'))::date
ORDER BY monday_date

panels.title: Share of YMML-YSSY airborne time flown by local pilots (latest Monday 0700-1200Z)
panels.description: Question F7 (v1 card 134), ADAPTED from Events: Monday event, not a plain copy (owner brief: only the latest Monday event). Definition: for the most recent Monday whose 0700Z start has passed (before 0700Z on a Monday it shows the Monday before), the share of airborne minutes on YMML-YSSY and YSSY-YMML flights ending between 0700 and 1200 UTC that were flown by pilots whose home airfield is in the home region (flights with airborne time only), with the airborne hours behind it. One row; the share is empty when there were no such flights. The original panel on Events: Monday event still shows every week. From 0700Z on a Monday the panel switches to that day's event, and the pilot figures are low or zero until about 2000Z because a flight is counted about 8 hours after its last position (controllers are live). Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH mon AS (
  SELECT (date_trunc('day', (now() - interval '7 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
          - (extract(isodow FROM (now() - interval '7 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int - 1) * interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS d
)
SELECT to_char(mon.d AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "Event date (UTC)",
       round(100.0 * COALESCE(sum(f.airborne_minutes) FILTER (WHERE f.pilot_is_local), 0) / NULLIF(sum(f.airborne_minutes), 0), 1) AS "Local pilots (%)",
       round(COALESCE(sum(f.airborne_minutes), 0) / 60.0, 1) AS "Airborne hours"
FROM mon LEFT JOIN flight_ext f
  ON f.end_time >= mon.d + interval '7 hours' AND f.end_time < mon.d + interval '12 hours'
  AND ((f.departure = 'YMML' AND f.arrival = 'YSSY') OR (f.departure = 'YSSY' AND f.arrival = 'YMML'))
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY mon.d

panels.title: Airborne aircraft during the latest Monday event (0700-1200Z, 5-minute slots)
panels.description: Question F8 (v1 card 156), copied unchanged from Events: Monday event. Definition: aircraft above 1000 ft in each 5-minute slot, 0700Z to 1155Z, on the most recent Monday whose 0700Z start has passed (before 0700Z on a Monday it shows the Monday before). Fixed to the latest Monday; there is no choice of date. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH mon AS (
  -- The most recent Monday whose 0700Z start has passed: 7 hours back from now, so Monday 00:00 to 06:59Z still shows last Monday
  SELECT (date_trunc('day', (now() - interval '7 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
          - (extract(isodow FROM (now() - interval '7 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int - 1) * interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS d
),
slots AS (
  SELECT mon.d + interval '7 hours' + n * interval '5 minutes' AS slot
  FROM mon CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 59) AS n
),
samples AS (
  SELECT s.observed_at, s.session_id
  FROM pilot_sample s
  WHERE s.observed_at >= (SELECT d FROM mon) + interval '7 hours'
    AND s.observed_at <  (SELECT d FROM mon) + interval '12 hours'
    AND s.alt_ft > 1000
)
SELECT sl.slot AS time,
       count(DISTINCT sa.session_id) AS "Airborne aircraft"
FROM slots sl
LEFT JOIN samples sa
       ON sa.observed_at >= sl.slot AND sa.observed_at < sl.slot + interval '5 minutes'
WHERE sl.slot <= now()
GROUP BY sl.slot
ORDER BY sl.slot

panels.title: Busiest days by flights (last 5 years)
panels.description: Question F9 (v1 card 128), copied unchanged from Pilots: traffic and aircraft. Definition: the five UTC dates with the most flights (by flight start) over the last 5 years. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (f.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS flight_date,
       trim(to_char(f.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'Day')) AS day_name,
       count(*) AS total_flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.start_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY total_flights DESC, flight_date DESC
LIMIT 5

panels.title: Busiest days by pilots online (last 5 years)
panels.description: Question F9 (v1 card 129), copied unchanged from Pilots: traffic and aircraft. Definition: the ten UTC dates with the most distinct pilots (by logon date) over the last 5 years, with weekday and rank. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS member_date,
       trim(to_char(f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'Day')) AS day_name,
       count(DISTINCT f.cid) AS unique_pilots,
       row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(DISTINCT f.cid) DESC, (f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date DESC) AS rank
FROM flight f
WHERE f.logon_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY unique_pilots DESC, member_date DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Flights per month, month on month (last 12 months)
panels.description: Question F10 (new). Definition: flights per calendar month (UTC), by the month the flight finished in, with the change on the previous month in per cent. Flights with airborne time only (a parked flight is not counted). HISTORY STARTS ON 07-10-2026 (go-live) and there is no backfill, so October 2026 is a part month and the month in progress is partial; compare only complete months with each other. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN min(end_time) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE greatest(date_trunc('month', min(end_time) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' - interval '11 months')) END AS first_month
  FROM flight_ext WHERE airborne_minutes > 0
), m AS (
  SELECT g AS month_start FROM bounds, generate_series(bounds.first_month, date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), interval '1 month') AS g
  WHERE bounds.first_month IS NOT NULL
), n AS (
  SELECT m.month_start, count(f.session_id) AS flights
  FROM m LEFT JOIN flight_ext f ON f.airborne_minutes > 0 AND f.end_time >= m.month_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND f.end_time < (m.month_start + interval '1 month') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
  GROUP BY m.month_start
)
SELECT to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month", flights AS "Flights",
       round(100.0 * (flights - lag(flights) OVER (ORDER BY month_start)) / NULLIF(lag(flights) OVER (ORDER BY month_start), 0), 1) AS "Change on previous month (%)",
       CASE WHEN month_start = date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') THEN 'month in progress'
            WHEN month_start = date_trunc('month', (SELECT go_live FROM data_since) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') THEN 'part month: from go-live' ELSE 'complete' END AS "Month status"
FROM n
ORDER BY month_start
